criteria.description: Organizes findings into themes, each supported by specific verbatim quotes or observed behaviors from the notes — not a generic narrative summary.
States how strongly each theme is supported (e.g. source count and/or a strong/moderate/weak rating), rather than asserting all findings with equal confidence.

Distinguishes what users DID (e.g. missed a deadline, gave up on QuickBooks, photographs receipts) from what they SAID they'd want (e.g. 'I'd use anything that connects to my bank'), weighting behavior as stronger.
Frames the underlying job-to-be-done / pain rather than jumping straight to features.
Acknowledges sample size / bias / what the data cannot yet tell us.
Recommends next research questions or cheap experiments, not a build plan.
